visualCharacteristics.structure: intro (h3 + p + Add palette to project pill) beside a carousel of four-color palette cards
visualCharacteristics.layout: Mobile: intro, then a full-width carousel of square palettes (four stacked swatches, 16px rounded), prev/next + 01/06 counter, full-width Add palette to project pill below. From 1024px: 12-column grid, intro columns 1-3 (sticky), carousel columns 5-12; 3:2 palette with the main color filling the left half and accent 1 / accent 2 / trim white stacked on the right, 24px rounded. Swatch name (bold) + code top-left, dark/light text by color contrast, near-white swatches get a hairline border. At most 6 palettes are shown.

contentPattern: Row 1 (optional): [h3 + p intro]. Rows 2..n: one cell with a ul of 4 color links whose text is CODE|Name|HEX (main, accent 1, accent 2, trim white). Links not in that form render as a plain swatch showing the link text.
